title: Major Netflix Horror Series Confirms Season 3 Return Thanks to October Success
content:
It’s been a good Halloween holiday season for one Netflix animated Horror series in particular as it has now confirmed it’s coming back for a third season not long after its Season 2 return. The spookiest time of the year comes with all kinds of desires to check out the spooky offerings now streaming with the platform , and Haunted Hotel is the perfect kind of series to scratch that itch. Especially with the debut of its second season earlier this October.

Haunted Hotel originally made its debut back in 2025 , and was such a hit that a second season was confirmed to be in the works pretty much immediately after. With that second season debuting earlier this October, Haunted Hotel has now proven itself enough of a success through the spooky October window to be confirmed for a third season now in the works for a release next year. Check out Netflix’s announcement teaser poster below.

Haunted Hotel Season 3 Confirmed for 2027 Netflix Release

Haunted Hotel Season 3 has been confirmed for a release with Netflix sometime in 2027, and it’s likely that the animated series will be hitting sometime during the same October window as the first two seasons . It’s just a perfect fit for the spooky holiday thanks to its blend of horror topics and comedy, and the second season takes that even further with more character layering and bigger adventures seen in each episode. It’s clearly building towards something even bigger as the team figures out more of its characters.

Created by Matt Roller, who also serves as executive producer alongside other Rick and Morty alum like Dan Harmon, Steve Levy, and Spider-Man: No Way Home ‘s Chris McKenna, Haunted Hotel features animation produced by Titmouse. Chris Prynoski, Shannon Prynoski, Antonio Canobbio and Ben Kalina are also serving as executive producers and Erica Hayes as supervising director. It also stars a packed core cast of Will Forte, Eliza Coupe, Skyler Gisondo, Natalie Palamides and more.

What’s So Special About Haunted Hotel?

Haunted Hotel has been a major surprise with Netflix . The animated series introduced fans to a family living in a hotel full of ghosts, and the developments across its first season proved it to be much deeper than its wacky premise would suggest. This continues into the second season as the team has been allowed to dive even deeper into all of their characters and their respective connections with one another. It’s building on the foundation already set to great success.

While the second season had been renewed pretty much immediately after its initial debut, this third season renewal came after a few weeks. It seems that the viewer numbers had been tracking more slowly for Haunted Hotel Season 2 compared to the first, but luckily the first month proved strong enough for another round coming next year. Are you excited to see more of Haunted Hotel coming to Netflix next year? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: After 5 Years, A Fan-Favorite Anime to Return With New Movie Ahead of Season 2
content:
It’s been five years since this anime first wrapped up its first season, but it has surprisingly announced it’s coming back with a new movie while Season 2 is now in the works. The anime adaptation for Aki Hamazi’s Bocchi the Rock! made its debut back in 2022, and was one of the most popular new anime releases of that year overall. It finally announced a few years after its original debut that a second season was in the works , but that’s now not the only surprise.

Bocchi the Rock! has announced that it’s coming to the big screen across Japan with a new feature film debut next year, and has actually revealed the first look at this surprise project with its first teaser trailer and visual. Setting up a prequel that will follow Nijika and her older sister, it’s going to give fans even more of a look at her life before the events of the main series . You can check out the first look at Bocchi the Rock ‘s new movie below.

Bocchi the Rock! Movie Announced for 2027 Ahead of Season 2

Bocchi the Rock! Hoshi no Ashiato will be making its debut across Japan sometime in 2027, but has yet to confirm a concrete release date or window as of this time. It has also yet to reveal whether or not it will be getting an international release, and we’ll likely find out sometime after it releases with an official English language title. The film adapts a special bonus chapter from Aki Hamazi’s original manga that sees Nijika Ichiji traveling together with her older sister Seika. The production staff for the film has been announced too.

Bocchi the Rock! Hoshi no Ashiato will be directed by Shin Wakabayashi for returning studio CloverWorks . Erika Yoshida returns from the TV anime series to provide the screenplay while Yukiko Horiguchi will be providing the character designs, and Akiko Fujita serves as sound director. But while this new feature film is hitting next year, thankfully it has also been confirmed that the previously announced Season 2 of the TV series is still in the works.

Bocchi the Rock Producer Shares Season 2 Update

Bocchi the Rock ! Season 2 is currently now in the works, but has no release window or date as of this time. It will be five years since the first season’s release when this new prequel film hits, so hopefully the new season won’t be too far off. CloverWorks producer Shouta Umehara took to social media to offer an update on the new season, “We’re currently in the midst of production for Season 2, with the script and storyboards reaching their final stages and animation progressing steadily, but we’ve gone ahead and announced the new movie!”

Bocchi the Rock! Season 2 still has no update on when it’s going to hit, but it seems like everything has been coming along nicely. Given just how well received that debut season really was, it’s probably for the best that the team behind it is taking all the time they need in order to have the best return possible. For now, catch up on Bocchi the Rock!’ s debut season with Crunchyroll in the meantime. Are you ready for its comeback? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 'Claymore' Creator Norihiro Yagi Begins New Manga
content:
Norihiro Yagi , the creator of Claymore , began serializing a new manga titled Batrlet Fairy Basslet on the Shounen Jump+ platform on Monday.

Yagi serialized Claymore in Monthly Shounen Jump from June 2001 to June 2007. Following the magazine's discontinuance, the manga switched to Jump SQ. in November 2007, where it ended in October 2014. Shueisha published the 27th and final volume in December 2014.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in July 2006 and published the 27th volume in October 2015.

Madhouse adapted the manga into a television anime that aired 26-episodes in Spring 2007. Funimation licensed the anime in North America and released it on home video.

Synopsis Brunhilde, a princess and the captain of her country's knights, defeats her archenemy and begins her journey back home. However, mysterious glowing fish suddenly rain down from the sky along the way, marking the beginning of an unexpected adventure.

title: One Piece Goes All Out for Fortnite With New Anime Opening – Watch Trailer
content:
One Piece has now come to Fortnite as part of a major new collaboration between the two massive franchises kicking off this month, and the studio behind One Piece’ s anime really went all out to celebrate with a special new anime opening to start it off on an explosive new foot. One Piece ‘s anime run might currently be on hiatus for the next few months while it works on the next season, but thankfully there’s even more to enjoy this month with a cool new trailer for the collab.

To celebrate One Piece’ s big debut as part of Fortnite ‘s Treasure Hunters event this month, Toei Animation has produced an official new trailer showing off the cool collaboration in a whole new way. Directed by Kokoro Kondo with Chiharu Akakura providing the new character designs, it’s really just one step closer to making a full Fortnite anime a reality. You can check it out in action below.

What to Know for New One Piece x Fortnite Collab

Fortnite Treasure Hunters is a special new event kicking off on November 1st as Epic Games will not only be introducing elements from One Piece with Luffy and the Straw Hats featured prominently in the event alongside fan favorite foes like Buggy the Clown, but all sorts of other surprises fans will see in action as the event continues. This new opening features a new staff at Toei Animation that helped bring it all to life, and the familiar Fortnite faces fit right into all of the other wildness of Eiichiro Oda’s world.

One Piece wrapped up the first phase of the Elbaph Arc with its episodes this year, and now it’s on hiatus before the anime returns for a new season next year . One Piece is no longer releasing new episodes on a weekly basis throughout the year, but instead will be releasing only 26 episodes a year across two cours. It’s a change in production schedule that means fewer episodes will be released a year overall, but at the same time the increased pace of the way it adapts the manga means the series has actually covered more ground.

What’s Next for One Piece in 2027?

One Piece has some huge plans for next year beyond the return of its TV anime’s Elbaph Arc episodes. One Piece has also confirmed that it’s now working on two new feature film productions, with the first scheduled for a release in Japan on 2027. Titled One Piece Film God Valley , the film has been teased to adapt the legendary God Valley flashback arc from Eiichiro Oda’s original manga. The second film is titled One Piece Film BAAD , and is currently scheduled for 2029. But no international release plans have been announced for them next.

One Piece is also returning to Netflix sometime in 2027 with the third season of its live-action series, One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta . No release date has been locked down for this one either, but Netflix will also be debuting a brand new remake anime series next year too. Coming to the platform in February 2027, The One Piece is a new anime from WIT Studio adapting it all from the very beginning . What do you think of Fortnite ‘s anime makeover with One Piece ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Bocchi the Rock Manga Gets Anime Film in 2027
content:
A teaser trailer announced on Sunday that a film adaptation of Aki Hamaji 's four-panel manga Bocchi the Rock! will open next year. Eiga Bocchi the Rock! Hoshi no Ashiato ( Bocchi the Rock! the Movie: Footprints of the Stars) will adapt "Hoshi ni Tamukeru Ai no Hana," the special story from the end of the fifth manga volume which recounts a prologue about Nijika Ichiji's older sister Seika.

Shin Wakabayashi ( Wonder Egg Priority ) is directing the film at CloverWorks , and Erika Yoshida is writing the screenplay. Yukiko Horiguchi is designing the characters.

The other staff members include:

• Stylist: Hiroaki Iriyama

• Color Key Artist: Kazuko Nakashima

• Art Director: Yuki Funagakure

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yūya Sakuma

• Editing: Daisuke Hiraki

• Sound Director: Akiko Fujita

• Graphic Design: Yūto Hama

• Distributor: Animec

Bocchi finally takes the stage in English, and she's brought her best friend— crippling anxiety! Hitori Goto just wants to make friends, but the thought of approaching a stranger on her own makes her so nervous that she's spent the entirety of middle school teaching herself how to shred on the guitar—to moderately successful (albeit anonymous) YouTube fame—in the hopes of seeming cool enough for someone else to reach out to her instead. After bringing her guitar to school provokes zero interest, Hitori's just about ready to shrivel up and die...which is when Nijika Ijichi comes across her moping in a playground and begs her to fill in for her band's flaky guitarist for their first-ever live performance! It's like her wish came true...but does this most antisocial of introverts have what it takes to perform in front of real people?!

The manga previously inspired a television anime that premiered in October 2022.

Hamaji launched the Bocchi the Rock! manga in Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara Max magazine in December 2017, and the series is ongoing. Houbunsha shipped the eighth compiled book volume on November 27. Yen Press shipped the seventh volume on November 11.

title: 'Charisma' Unveils Additional Cast, Teaser Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of the Charisma House mixed-media project unveiled a pair of additional cast and teaser promotional video on Sunday. The anime series will premiere on TBS affiliate networks at 11:56 p.m. on January 7, 2027.

Voice actors Shinnosuke Tachibana ( Kamisama Hajimemashita ) and Tomohiro Oono ( Tomodachi Game ) are joining the cast as Souemon Nakagami and Shuu Torahime, respectively.

A short anime adaptation of Charisma will begin airing on November 4 at 11:56 p.m. as part of TBS's Yoru no Brunch program.

Jouji Furuta ( Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Maji Love Legend Star ) is directing the anime at Pierrot Films , with Shuu Matsubara ( Osomatsu-san ) handling the series composition and script. Haru Watanabe ( Kawagoe Boys Sing ) is adapting the original character design by Ebimo ( Let's Play: Quest-darake no My Life ). Gesshoku Kaigi ( Back Street Girls: Gokudolls ) is composing the music.

King Records launched the Charisma House multimedia project under its Evil Line Records label in August 2021. The project includes manga adaptations, music releases, audio dramas, and stage plays.

Rin Manda and Iori Irino serialized a manga adaptation titled Charisma: Kyou mo Heiwa desu in Dessert magazine from January 2023 to December 2024. The second volume went on sale on March 13 last year.

Sou Tobita launched a spin-off manga titled Charisma: Charisma na Karera wa Charisma House de Karizumai-chu in the Comic DAYS magazine, which ran from February 2023 to December 2023. The second volume was released in February 2024.

title: 'Bocchi the Rock!' Gets Prequel Anime Movie in 2027
content:
The official website of the Bocchi the Rock! anime series announced a new prequel anime movie subtitled Hoshi no Ashiato , revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and an announcement promo on Sunday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in 2027.

Voice actresses Maaya Uchida ( Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! ) and Sayumi Suzushiro ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai ) are starring as Seika Ijichi and Nijika Ijichi, respectively.

Staff Director: Shin Wakabayashi ( Wonder Egg Priority ) Script: Erika Yoshida ( Kami no Tou ) Character Design: Yukiko Horiguchi ( K-On! ) Stylist: Hiroaki Iriyama Color Design: Kazuko Nakashima ( Sword Art Online ) Art Director: Yuuki Funao ( Uchiage Hanabi, Shita kara Miru ka? Yoko kara Miru ka? ) Director of Photography: Yuuya Sakuma ( Darling in the FranXX ) Editor: Daisuke Hiraki ( Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru ) Sound Director: Akiko Fujita ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) Graphic Design: Yuto Hama Studio: CloverWorks Distributor: ANIMEC

Produced by CloverWorks, the television anime adapting Aki Hamaji 's 4-koma music comedy manga aired in 12 episodes in Fall 2022. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with subtitles in multiple languages. A two-part compilation movie premiered in Japan in June 2024 and August 2024.

The Kessoku Bando ZEPP TOUR 2024 "We will" announced a second season television anime adaptation for the series.

Hamaji began serializing the manga in Manga Time Kirara MAX in December 2017. The series went on hiatus on January 19 due to the author's health issues before resuming serialization on June 18. Houbunsha published the eighth volume in November 2025.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in April 2023 and released the seventh volume in October 2025. The eighth volume is scheduled for a November 24 release.

Introduction The movie follows Seika Ijichi, Nijika Ijichi's older sister, and tells a story of dreams beginning with the Ijichi sisters' separation ten years ago.

Announcement

Hamaji began serializing the manga in Manga Time Kirara MAX in December 2017. The series went on hiatus on January 19 due to the author's health issues before resuming serialization on June 18. Houbunsha published the eighth volume in November 2025.
Yen Press licensed the manga in English in April 2023 and released the seventh volume in October 2025. The eighth volume is scheduled for a November 24 release.
Introduction The movie follows Seika Ijichi, Nijika Ijichi's older sister, and tells a story of dreams beginning with the Ijichi sisters' separation ten years ago.

title: Bocchi the Rock Gets Movie Starring Nijika and Seika in 2027
content:
Bocchi the Rock is getting a movie in 2027 that stars Nijika and Seika. CloverWorks is animating the series with Shin Wakabayashi as director. Erika Yoshida is handling the series composition while Yukiko Horiguchi is designing the characters. An announcement trailer was also released:

It was also confirmed that Sayumi Suzushiro and Maaya Uchida will reprise their roles as Nijika and Seika, respectively. A teaser visual was also unveiled:

The second season of Bocchi the Rock was confirmed last February 2025, with the first season’s assistant director, Yusuke Yamamoto, replacing Keiichiro Saito. The main cast of the anime will reprise their roles for season 2:

• Yoshino Aoyama as Hitori “Bocchi” Goto

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Nijika Ijichi

• Saku Mizuno as Ryo Yamada

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Ikuyo Kita

The first season of the anime premiered on October 9, 2022. Crunchyroll is streaming and they describe it as follows: Hitori Gotoh, “Bocchi-chan,” is a girl who’s so introverted and shy around people that she’d always start her conversations with “Ah…” During her middle school years, she started playing the guitar, wanting to join a band because she thought it could be an opportunity for even someone shy like her to also shine. But because she had no friends, she ended up practicing guitar for six hours every day all by herself. After becoming a skilled guitar player, she uploaded videos of herself playing the guitar to the internet under the name “Guitar Hero” and fantasized about performing at her school’s cultural festival concert. But not only could she not find any bandmates, before she knew it, she was in high school and still wasn’t able to make a single friend! She was really close to becoming a shut-in, but one day, Nijika Ijichi, the drummer in Kessoku Band, reached out to her. And because of that, her everyday life started to change little by little…
